entries.target: An infinite range status skill that applies to 7 friendly targets.
entries.officialDescription: Touch the darkness within yourself and your allies by drawing out their twisted inclinations. Applies Depravity, increasing you and your allies' Dodge, Crit Chance, and Outgoing Damage by 30%. Immorality strengthens your magic, increasing your Haste by 20%, Crit Damage by 30%, and healing you over time. Also applies Arcane Shield, reducing non True Damage taken by 30% of your Spell Power and draining 8 mana when hit. Effects last 12 seconds.
notes: Arcane Shield cannot be removed by bosses.
Depravity and Immorality refresh but do not stack.
The HoT from Immorality heals every 1 second.
